netlist:
* Spicey Electrons circuit at 20 C
.options rshunt=1e12 reltol=1e-3 method=gear
.temp 20
vam_B1 n1 B1_am 0
V_B1 B1_int 0 PWL(0 0 1e-06 9)
R_B1_in B1_am B1_int 0.1
vam_R1 n1 R1_am 0
R_R1 R1_am n2 470
vam_LED1 n2 LED1_am 0
D_LED1 LED1_am 0 LED_red
.model LED_red D(IS=3.2850e-17 N=2.0 RS=2.0 EG=2.300 XTI=3 BV=5 IBV=10u CJO=20p TT=10n)
.control
set filetype=binary
tran 1e-05 0.01 0 1e-05
write __OUT__ v(n1) v(n2) i(vam_b1) i(vam_r1) i(vam_led1)
quit
.endc
.end
